course.title: Linear Integrated Circuits and Digital Systems

content.value: A sequential circuit has three D flip-flops (A, B, C) and one input, x. it is described by the following flip-flop input functions.
i) Derive the state table for the circuit.
ii) Draw two state diagrams: one for x = 0 and the other for x = 1
